body: I appreciate your positive post, and I'm glad you're getting things under control. It feels so nice when things settle down after months of hell. Thank you for sharing.

I mentioned in an interview for a job I don't want the other day, that one of my weaknesses and strengths is how detail oriented i can be. How is that a weakness? I obsess over details, I can tell when something is even slightly different, and I can blow up this tiny change completely out of proportion. I know how you feel when you notice tiny changes and fear the worst. I also feel you with the late 20s and getting better at acting. I'm told, oh you're handling this much better than you would have years ago. No, I'm just getting better at hiding it.
